Write the comparison as a standalone HTML report

Source: R/report.R
write_dossier_html.Rd

Writes a folder that opens in any browser: dossier.html, data.js (the same data as write_dossier_json()), notes.js (the hand-written findings) and img/ with the plot pairs. The page shows the provenance of both versions, the labelled differences, and per scenario the timings, side-by-side diffs of console output and printed values, the numbers that moved, the element names gained or lost, and the plot pairs with a pixel-difference view.

Usage

write_dossier_html(x, dir, notes = NULL)

Arguments

x

An pkgdossier_comparison from compare_runs().

dir

Folder to write; created if needed.

notes

Optional path to a notes file to copy into the folder as notes.js.

Value

The path of dossier.html, invisibly.

Details

The findings, per-scenario takeaways and extra method notes come from notes.js, the one file written by hand; its format is documented in the template the first call copies into the folder (system.file("report", "notes-template.js", package = "pkgdossier")). An existing notes.js in the folder is kept.

Examples

# \donttest{
d <- example_dossier()
prepare_versions(d, quiet = TRUE)
run_scenarios(d, quiet = TRUE)
cmp <- compare_runs(d)
page <- write_dossier_html(cmp, dir = file.path(tempdir(), "dossier-page"))
# open it with utils::browseURL(page)
# }
